headword: {情緒不安定|じょうちょふあんてい}
reading: じょうちょふあんてい

definitions.explanation: A state where one's emotions fluctuate greatly and are difficult to control. Used both casually to describe mood swings and in psychological or medical contexts.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}{情緒不安定|じょうちょふあんてい}だ。
{睡眠不足|すいみんぶそく}で{情緒不安定|じょうちょふあんてい}になった。
examples.english: I became emotionally unstable from lack of sleep.

examples.japanese: {思春期|ししゅんき}は{情緒不安定|じょうちょふあんてい}になりやすい{時期|じき}だと{言|い}われている。
examples.english: Puberty is said to be a time when people are prone to emotional instability.

notes:
A four-character compound of {情緒|じょうちょ} (emotions, sentiment) + {不安定|ふあんてい} (unstable). Used both in everyday conversation and in medical/psychological contexts. Note that {情緒|じょうちょ} can also be read じょうしょ.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {情緒不安定|じょうちょふあんてい}になる — to become emotionally unstable
- {情緒不安定|じょうちょふあんてい}な{状態|じょうたい} — emotionally unstable state
- {情緒不安定|じょうちょふあんてい}{気味|ぎみ} — somewhat emotionally unstable

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {情緒|じょうちょ}{不安|ふあん} — emotional anxiety
- メンタルが{不安定|ふあんてい} — mentally unstable (casual)
- {気分|きぶん}の{浮|う}き{沈|しず}み — mood swings
- {精神的|せいしんてき}に{不安定|ふあんてい} — psychologically unstable
